purpose: Artistic concepts of the proposed Assembly Yard (Factorio-inspired) map. Artistic visualization, not engine screenshots or exact level geometry.

images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Standalone landscape 16:9 concept image of ASSEMBLY YARD, a playable 3D tank party arena in Godot inspired by Factorio. One complete image, no collage. Stylized clean, cheerful, toy-like low-poly realtime videogame graphics matching Godot 4 PBR aesthetic (chunky bevelled shapes, readable broad combat space, clean materials, soft shadows). Perspective: Third-person gameplay camera about 9m behind the tank, gently looking downward across the factory arena, with horizon and distant backdrop visible. Foreground: A small cobalt-blue toy scout tank in rear three-quarter view, angular enamel hull, separate turret with short cannon, dark rubber tracks, cyan optic. One or two contrasting red/orange enemy tanks in the middle ground for scale. Tank is around 2m wide. Arena elements: Active industrial conveyor belts with black-and-yellow hazard chevron stripes running across the floor, carrying metal crates with gear logos. Classic Factorio-style yellow articulated robotic inserters (two-jointed robotic arms with mechanical claw grippers) positioned along the conveyor belts behind low safety railings. Industrial blocky cover: an electric smelting furnace with a glowing orange furnace window, stacks of steel plates, and assembling machine covers with ventilation louvres. Raised catwalk/terrace 3m high on one side with wide industrial ramps. Floor: Dark graphite steel decking, diamond tread plates, yellow hazard markings along platform edges. Backdrop: Giant automated factory sprawling into the distance under an open overcast sky with dramatic factory smokestacks emitting soft white steam, giant robotic arms, and cooling towers. Below arena perimeter: Glowing orange molten metal / smelting trench reflecting light upward onto the bottom edges of the arena. No text, HUD, labels, logos, or watermarks.

Use case: stylized-concept. Standalone landscape 16:9 concept art image of FACTORY SMELTER (Factorio-inspired tank arena for TANKUS). Key Scene Elements & Layout: 1. Centerpiece: A massive square industrial smelting furnace / incinerator pit right in the center of the factory floor, glowing with intense orange molten metal, sparks, and heat shimmer. 2. Elevated Bridge Conveyor: A high, narrow steel conveyor bridge (at +3.5m height) runs straight from north to south directly OVER the glowing molten furnace pit, transporting newly crafted steel gear wheels. The conveyor exits the arena through heavy factory bulkhead gates in the distance. 3. Left Side Supply Line: On the left (west) perimeter, a row of bright yellow Factorio-style robotic inserters (two-jointed robotic arms with mechanical claw grippers) actively grab steel gear wheels from pallets and feed them onto a conveyor line that ramps up onto the elevated bridge. 4. Scrap / Waste Chutes: Two side conveyor belts (from the southwest and northeast corners) transport scrap metal, broken parts, and metal crates with gear logos, dumping them directly over the edge into the central molten furnace. 5. Gameplay Perspective: Third-person chase camera about 9m behind a small cobalt-blue toy scout tank in the foreground with enamel finish and dark tracks. Across the arena, a contrasting red enemy tank is navigating the narrow conveyor bridge above the blazing furnace. 6. Atmosphere & Floor: Dark graphite diamond-plate steel flooring, bold yellow-and-black diagonal hazard stripes along the conveyor rails and furnace rim. Factory backdrop with massive ventilation pipes, cooling towers, and smokestacks venting white steam under industrial halogen work lights. 7. Style: Stylized clean, cheerful, low-poly realtime videogame graphics matching Godot 4 PBR aesthetic (chunky bevelled shapes, readable broad combat space, clean materials, soft shadows). No text, HUD, labels, or watermarks.
